from collections import Counter
p="/Users/mac/.dc-platform/logs/ethan-jobs-watch.stderr.log"
# file may not have dates; count key phrases near end
keys=("TimeoutError","Connection to Telegram failed","Server closed","DM failed","watch handler","FloodWait","disconnected")
c=Counter()
# sample last 2000 lines only
with open(p,"rb") as f:
    f.seek(0,2)
    size=f.tell()
    f.seek(max(0,size-400_000))
    data=f.read().decode("utf-8","replace")
lines=data.splitlines()
print(f"tail bytes window lines={len(lines)} size={size}")
for line in lines:
    for k in keys:
        if k in line:
            c[k]+=1
print(dict(c))
print("--- last non-empty unique-ish ---")
for line in lines[-15:]:
    print(line[:200])
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
import re, urllib.request
channels = ["haiwaigaoxin","remotejob18","ly999991","RemoteJobsCN","kebukeyi26","duidui007"]
ua={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}
for ch in channels:
    url=f"https://t.me/s/{ch}"
    try:
        req=urllib.request.Request(url, headers=ua)
        html=urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20).read().decode("utf-8","replace")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"\n== {ch} FAIL {e}")
        continue
    # datetime + nearby text snippet
    parts=re.findall(r'datetime="([^"]+)"[\s\S]{0,80}?tgme_widget_message_text[^>]*>([\s\S]{0,180})', html)
    if not parts:
        dts=re.findall(r'datetime="([^"]+)"', html)
        print(f"\n== {ch} posts={len(dts)} last={dts[-3:] if dts else None} (no text parse)")
        continue
    print(f"\n== {ch} n={len(parts)} latest={parts[-1][0] if parts else None}")
    for dt, raw in parts[-4:]:
        text=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',raw)
        text=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',text).strip()[:90]
        print(f"  {dt} | {text}")
PY
